# Summary
Three CSV exports prepared around June 5 2026 for import into monday.com: a master list (rolled-up tasks with status and time), a done list (11 completed tasks with time spent) and a to-do list (16 pending tasks with priority and estimates). They capture the late-May / early-June location-page audit and schema work.

# Done (about 9 hours total)
**Summit (3 hrs):** AEO/GEO/SEO audit of 114 location pages with CSV report; 7 Emergency Plumbing pages given unique titles/metas; 6 wrong-city bleed pages fixed (fixture x3, pipe lining x2, sewer x1); 38 SEO titles trimmed to 60 chars or less. All verified live.
**Alphalete (1.7 hrs):** audit of 133 location pages; wrong-city scan clean; mu-plugin v1.2.0 confirmed, FAQ layer not deployed.
**Pipeliners (4.25 hrs):** read-only audit of 37 city pages found OTTO deploying the wrong Course schema; Metasync test post set to noindex; Course removed and Service schema deployed on 30 city pages (14 metros + 16 long-tail; 6 had no OTTO entry); removal verified live.

# Pending (from the to-do list)
| Task | Client | Priority | Est. |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fix H1 on 27 pages (22 with none, 5 Water Softener with 3) | Summit | High | 2 to 3 hrs |
| Add visible FAQ to 10 General Plumbing pages (schema without visible FAQ is a risk) | Summit | High | 1.5 to 2 hrs |
| Build 8 missing service-area pages (Water Softener x5 + 3 others) | Summit | Medium | 3 to 4 hrs |
| Service schema on service pages (0/114), via mu-plugin | Summit | Low | 1 hr |
| Alt text on 36 images | Summit | Low | 1 hr |
| Confirm water-heater-fountain-hills 301 to Phoenix intent | Summit | Low | 15 min |
| FAQPage schema on 18 location pages (Elementor accordion) | Alphalete | Medium | 2 to 3 hrs |
| Fix duplicate H1 site-wide (130/133 pages, logo as H1) | Alphalete | Medium | 30 min |
| LocalBusiness/Plumber schema on 45 Hydro pages | Alphalete | Low | 1 hr |
| Template bugs ("We proudly serves", duplicate sections) | Alphalete | Low | 1 hr |
| Build Manitou Springs Drain Cleaning page | Alphalete | Low | 30 min |
| FAQ on 20 Pipeliners city pages | Pipeliners | Low | 3 to 4 hrs |
| Fix Course schema on blog/service pages (blogs may need Article) | Pipeliners | Low | 30 min |
| Alt text on about 56 images (16 percent missing) | Pipeliners | Low | 1.5 hrs |
| Ask Search Atlas support to fix OTTO Course default | Pipeliners | Medium | 15 min |
| Verify Service schema propagated after OTTO sync | Pipeliners | Low | 15 min |

Later notes in the vault show several of these were handled or superseded (for example the Alphalete duplicate H1 root cause); treat this list as a June snapshot.
